$comment: The cyberpunk skin's only art (README.md, "Art"): five white sprites with alpha that python3 tools/nui_skin_art.py build draws from these numbers (1x pixels) into cyberpunk-1x.png, cyberpunk-2x.png and cyberpunk-sprites.rcss. RCSS rounds corners only, and a 45-degree cut corner on a box of any size would cost two nested mask layers per element per frame; a ninepatch of white art tinted by image-color draws it as one cached decorator in the player's colors.
